description: Mages, species, populace cohorts, universities, and the economy.
author: Ann Kelner
//: Rules-path code: no third-party runtime dependencies, no Node built-ins, integer-only. Per contracts.md §5 it may import sim-core, content, state, and primitives — and MUST NOT import rules-magic or agent-api. Only the two it actually imports are declared: an undeclared-but-imported dependency resolves through workspace hoisting and breaks the moment the package is consumed from outside this repository, while a declared-but-unused one is a boundary nobody is really holding.
